drawings.title: Common Flicker Tree
drawings.alt: Graphite sketch of a common flicker clinging vertically to the side of a tree trunk.
drawings.note: Feather markings and the long vertical line of a tree trunk.

drawings.title: Raven
drawings.alt: Graphite profile study of a raven facing left, with a bright eye, heavy beak, and folded wing.
drawings.note: An expressive eye and carefully layered feathers.

drawings.title: Carolina Wren
drawings.alt: Graphite sketch of a Carolina wren perched in left-facing profile, with its compact body and tail cocked sharply upward.
drawings.note: A small bird, a lifted tail, and a lively perch.

drawings.title: Scissor Tailed Flycatcher
drawings.alt: Graphite sketch of a scissor-tailed flycatcher perched in profile, its long tail extending below the branch.
drawings.note: A spare profile carried by a long, sweeping tail.

drawings.title: Red Eyed Vireo
drawings.alt: Graphite sketch of a rounded red-eyed vireo perched on a thin twig and facing left.
drawings.note: A quiet study of posture and proportion.

scenes.title: The Antler Clearing
scenes.alt: An antlered deer lowers its head to a shaggy owl in a quiet snowy clearing, touching the offered tip of a wing.
scenes.note: Warm light and a quiet encounter in a winter clearing.
scenes.description: An antlered deer lowers its head to a shaggy owl in a quiet snowy clearing, touching the offered tip of a wing.

scenes.title: Birdsong Assembly
scenes.alt: A raven, long-tailed flycatcher, red-eyed vireo, and common flicker occupy lightly drawn branches above tiny firs and a few oak leaves.
scenes.note: Bird studies gather in an airy graphite landscape.
scenes.description: Four very different birds find their own perches in a quiet stand of trees.

scenes.title: One Foot on the River
scenes.alt: An antler-crowned paddler steadies a curved canoe while a leaf-horned faun steps aboard from a root-bound bank in a green pine valley.
scenes.note: A shared task among the roots at the river's edge.
scenes.description: An antler-crowned paddler steadies a curved canoe while a leaf-horned faun steps aboard from a root-bound bank in a green pine valley.

scenes.title: Rain Beneath the Bell
scenes.alt: A striped spiral-eyed worm and a root-footed four-leaf figure take shelter beneath a hanging bell flower while fine pencil rain falls around scattered leaves.
scenes.note: A botanical drawing becomes a shelter from the rain.
scenes.description: A hanging flower becomes a shelter for two small notebook creatures.

scenes.title: The Windward Terraces
scenes.alt: Pencil landscape: A horned woodland gathering watches a great inked leaf drift across terraces of trees and tall corn.
scenes.note: A broad landscape assembled around terraces, trees, and distant ridges.
scenes.description: A horned woodland gathering watches a great inked leaf drift across terraces of trees and tall corn.

scenes.title: The Lantern Appointment
scenes.alt: The crocodile lights the snail through a crooked village gate with a flower-tasseled lantern.
scenes.note: A small shared gesture in blue night and lantern light.
